name: Batappli
positioning: A long-standing French building trades package covering quote, invoice and accounting in one product.
description: Batappli is management software for French construction and trade businesses: quotes and invoices with work libraries, progress billing, purchase and stock, site follow-up, customer records and integrated accounting, available on desktop and cloud.
real_estate_use: Its buyer is the established trade business that wants one supplier for commercial documents and books rather than a modern SaaS plus an accountant's package. The integrated accounting is the differentiator: the invoice posts directly, so the year-end handover to the expert-comptable is a file rather than a reconstruction.
features: Quotes and invoices with trade work libraries

use_cases.job: Keep commercial documents and accounting in one package for the year-end handover
Produce trade quotes from a maintained work and price library
